snippet.title: Prehistoric Safari Magnavox Odyssey 1972
snippet.description:
Prehistoric Safari is a shooter video game released in 1972 for Magnavox Odyssey. It uses the game card 9, an overlay of prehistoric animals and the light gun (rifle). 

One player sets their dot on overlays of prehistoric animals, while the other player attempts to shoot the dot with the light gun. After 15 shots, the Player Control Unit is traded for the rifle and the procedure is repeated.

Whoever extinguishes the most targets in only 15 attempts is the winner.

Source: https://archive.org/details/OdySim/page/42/mode/2up

Gameplay: OdySim Simulator 1080p 60 FPS
